token_id.description: Exact registry token key, e.g. uniswap:UNI.

updated_markdown.description: Complete replacement text. In automatic edits substitute facts line by line, keep every section title, add no lines and grow the text by at most 1,000 characters.

reason.description: One sentence explaining which verified event requires these updates.

claim_ids.description: Accepted verified claim IDs from the current event.

user_requested_expansion.description: True only when the user explicitly asks to add material in a follow-up.
